heading: Monday, July 21, 2025
topLine: Gemini Deep Think achieves officially certified gold-medal score at IMO 2025. Also: Alibaba releases updated Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct-2507.

items.headline: Gemini Deep Think achieves officially certified gold-medal score at IMO 2025
items.summary: Google DeepMind's advanced Gemini Deep Think solved five of the six IMO 2025 problems end to end in natural language within the 4.5-hour limit, for 35 of 42 points. IMO coordinators graded and certified the result using the same criteria as for student solutions. IMO President Gregor Dolinar confirmed it as a gold-medal score.

image.alt: Header image from the Google DeepMind IMO 2025 announcement

items.headline: Alibaba releases updated Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct-2507
items.summary: Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct-2507 is an updated non-thinking version of Qwen's flagship open model with 256K native context, released under Apache 2.0 as Qwen moved to separate instruct and thinking models. Qwen reports large gains over the original, e.g. AIME25 70.3 vs 24.7.
